name: codex-win-update-repair
description: Diagnose and repair incomplete Windows Codex Desktop runtime extraction after AppX updates.

interface.shortDescription: Repair incomplete Windows runtime staging after Codex updates.
interface.longDescription: A Codex skill plus an independent PowerShell utility for auditing and safely repairing the bundled Windows runtime after a Microsoft Store update. The utility can run without Codex being open.
defaultPrompt: Audit and repair my Windows Codex runtime
